name: Low-Bandwidth Knowledge and Operations OS
promise: Preserve context and expose the next safe action when bandwidth is low.
completion_criteria: One SourceRecord path preserves capture, checksum, provenance, retrieval citation, and projection ownership.
Generated Observer notes cannot be ingested back as new canonical sources.
JARVIS presents and approves actions without duplicating storage or domain logic.
Unique Ryos and master-plan behavior is ported or rejected before their runtimes are retired.
Daily operation retains deterministic fallbacks when providers or credentials are unavailable.

waves.objective: Model capture to PKOS to Observer projection with one SourceRecord fixture in the suite-local engine.
waves.acceptance: The fixture is content-addressed and cited, the projected note preview is stable and fenced from re-ingestion, and mutation protection holds. Donor repositories are fingerprinted, not written to.
waves.runtime_followup: Ingest a real captured source through the live PKos runtime and land the projected note in the actual Observer vault.

waves.objective: Inventory Ryos core files and master-plan specs read from live source against dotfiles and Observer.
waves.acceptance: Ryos and master-plan files are enumerated from the working trees and each catalogued behavior carries a port target, explicit rejection, or preserved historical owner. No port is executed.
waves.runtime_followup: Execute the assigned ports in dotfiles and back each with a test, or record the rejection.

waves.objective: Model a JARVIS action preview receipt with an approval boundary in the suite-local engine, against a fingerprinted JARVIS source.
waves.acceptance: The preview receipt requires human approval, is dry-run only, and creates no duplicate state. JARVIS is fingerprinted, not invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Drive a real JARVIS action through preview, approval, execution receipt, failure, and recovery over owned APIs or file contracts.

waves.objective: Model a multi-source PKOS intake batch with fenced Observer projections in the suite-local engine.
waves.acceptance: A batch of at least three fixture sources produces content-addressed SourceRecords, each cited and fenced from re-ingestion.
waves.runtime_followup: Run the real day-to-day daily-notes stream through the live PKos capture path.

waves.objective: Formalize the disposition of the Ryos and master-plan inventory: name port targets, superseded features, and canonical anchors.
waves.acceptance: Every duplicate decision is closed on paper with dotfiles and PKos named as sole operational anchors, and at least two port candidates are assigned. No code is ported and no donor is retired.
waves.runtime_followup: Port the named launcher features into dotfiles and retire the duplicate donors.

waves.objective: Generalize the modelled JARVIS action pattern to multiple commands with a full approval and receipt lifecycle in the suite-local engine.
waves.acceptance: Preview, human approval gate, execution receipt, and fail-closed rejection of unapproved execution are verified across a multi-action surface with zero disk mutations.
waves.runtime_followup: Run the same lifecycle against real JARVIS commands that perform actual side effects.
